column2: Wen Ping holding a river crossing against a charging army: he stands firm before a planted banner, sword raised high to order his men to hold the line, cloak whipping, head turned toward the enemy with his whole face visible. Expression: steadfast, unshaken calm.

Lu Bu, the mightiest warrior of the Three Kingdoms, standing alone before an entire army at Hulao Pass, seen from below, thrusting his huge crescent-bladed halberd toward the viewer; pheasant feathers sweeping, cape whipping. Expression: contemptuous snarl. (v0.7 견줘 보기에서 고른 그림 — 화풍 본만 넣은 문구는 art/prompts-v0.7.txt)

Diaochan, the most beautiful woman of the Three Kingdoms, in a moonlit peony garden, holding a round silk fan beside her cheek and glancing sidelong at the viewer with a gentle, bright, self-assured smile; full moon behind. Expression: warm, lively, confident. (v0.7 견줘 보기에서 고른 그림)

Xu Sheng on a river bank holding a signal flag high and shouting; the flag is a bare piece of plain cloth streaming in the wind with absolutely no writing, no characters, no symbols and no emblem on it; behind him pale strokes of a long palisade. Expression: stout-hearted.
